verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs say recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized. Its API exposes a per-call summary endpoint, covering both regular and Sona-handled calls, with a dedicated summary webhook, and call transcripts are accessible through its MCP integration. Summaries are gated to Business and Scale plans. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed first-party docs on how transcripts attach to the conversation thread, availability on lower-tier plans.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Retrieve a detailed summary of a specific call identified by its unique call ID. This endpoint supports summaries for both regular calls and calls handled by Sona.
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English.
